# HackMates

> HackMates is a student developer community and innovation ecosystem in India. We build real-world AI and full-stack software products, compete in and win hackathons, and provide mentorship, pre-built academic projects, and verified engineering internships.

## Primary Pages & Resources

- [Home](https://hackmates.tech/): Overview of the HackMates student innovation ecosystem.
- [Projects Catalog](https://hackmates.tech/projects): Complete directory of full-stack web, AI/ML, PHP, and Data Science software built by our engineers.
- [Hackathon Journey & Milestones](https://hackmates.tech/journey): Chronological timeline of hackathon victories, prizes, and batches.
- [Core Team & Interns](https://hackmates.tech/team): Meet the founders, lead engineers, and student builders.
- [Services & Offerings](https://hackmates.tech/services): Pre-built projects, custom full-stack development, mentorship, and 12-week internship programs.
- [Event Gallery](https://hackmates.tech/gallery): Highlights and photos from workshops and hackathons.
- [Verify Certificate](https://hackmates.tech/verify): Official credential and internship completion verification portal.
- [Contact Us](https://hackmates.tech/contact): Partnership inquiries, mentorship requests, and community links.

## Key Capabilities & Focus Areas

- **AI & Full-Stack Engineering**: Voice deepfake detection (VocalGuard), smart roommate matching (RoomBridge), career mentors, and healthcare AI.
- **Hackathon Acceleration**: National hackathon participation, winning strategies, team matching, and rapid MVP shipping.
- **Academic Project Development**: Production-ready software with documentation, architecture diagrams, and viva preparation for Diploma, B.E., and B.Tech students.
